dek: The Commissioner of Customs and Excise, Mr Chan Tsz-tat, led a delegation to visit Dalian and Qingdao from August 19 to 22, and attended the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) Customs-Business Dialogue held in Dalian.
